name: Meerkat
group: Animals > Mammals > Wild animals on land > Eats mostly insects

features.claim: It is a small mongoose with a slim build.
features.quote: The meerkat is a small mongoose of slim build characterised by a broad head, large eyes, a pointed snout, long legs, a thin tapering tail, and a brindled coat pattern.

features.claim: It has a broad head with large eyes and a pointed snout.
features.quote: It is characterised by a broad head, large eyes, a pointed snout, long legs, a thin tapering tail, and a brindled coat pattern.

features.claim: It has long legs and a thin tapering tail.
features.quote: It is characterised by a broad head, large eyes, a pointed snout, long legs, a thin tapering tail, and a brindled coat pattern.

features.claim: Its head and body together are about 24 to 35 cm long.
features.quote: The head-and-body length is around 24–35 cm (9.4–13.8 in), and the weight is typically between 0.62 and 0.97 kg (1.4 and 2.1 lb).

features.claim: Its soft coat is light grey to yellowish brown with poorly defined light and dark bands on the back.
features.quote: The soft coat is light grey to yellowish brown with alternate, poorly defined light and dark bands on the back.
Its head is mostly white, and the underparts are covered sparsely with dark reddish-brown fur, with the dark skin underneath showing through.

features.claim: Its underparts have sparse dark reddish-brown fur with dark skin showing through.
features.quote: Its head is mostly white, and the underparts are covered sparsely with dark reddish-brown fur, with the dark skin underneath showing through.

features.claim: Its slim yellowish tail is 17 to 25 cm long and tipped with black.
features.quote: The slim, yellowish tail, unlike the bushy tails of many other mongooses, measures 17 to 25 cm (6.7 to 9.8 in), and is tipped with black.

features.claim: It has big, sharp, curved front claws for digging.
features.quote: The big, sharp and curved foreclaws (slightly longer than the hindclaws) are highly specialised among the feliforms, and enable the meerkat to dig efficiently.

features.claim: Its black, crescent-like ears can be closed.
features.quote: The black, crescent-like ears can be closed to prevent the entry of dirt and debris while digging.

features.claim: It has four toes on each foot with thick pads underneath.
features.quote: Digitigrade, the meerkat has four digits on each foot with thick pads underneath.

features.claim: It stands up on its back legs and uses its tail to balance.
features.quote: The meerkat uses its tail to balance because it stands up on its back legs to look for predators.
